_meta.ptally/summary: Shows every quote in one client journey, oldest first, so you can see how the case's price and validity changed up to where it stands now.
_meta.swallow/summary: Shows every quote in one client journey, oldest first, so you can see how the case's price and validity changed up to where it stands now.

description: Every quote saved with one `client_ref`, oldest first, in the get_quotes shape: the journey from its first quote to its latest. Returns `{ client_ref, start_date, end_date, quote_count, limit, offset, has_more, quotes: [{ quote_reference, project_reference, project_name, version_reference, version, created_at, status, valid, result, indicator, client_ref, exec_time_ms, error, amended_result, amended_valid, sold, quote_url }], journey_url, next_steps }`. The last quote is where the case stands now; compare `result` and `valid` from one quote to the next to explain what changed, and call get_quote with a quote_reference for one quote's full review (inputs, rules that fired, how the price was built). Paged with `limit` (default and max 100) and `offset`. A client_ref with no quotes is a tool error.

client_ref.description: The journey's client_ref (exact match), from get_journeys or a quote's client_ref.

limit.description: Optional. Page size, default and max 100.

offset.description: Optional. Quotes to skip from the start of the journey, for paging.

name: get_journey
title: Read a client journey
